QuestInfo.name: [Instrument] The Challenge of Orpheus!
QuestInfo.1:
Cassandra told you to bring all of the Sheet Music left by the legendary bard, Orpheus. You're not sure how all these little dots and lines are supposed to help, though...


#bIt seems like monsters 11 levels higher or lower than your current level do not have the Sheet Music, unless they are level 150 or higher.
QuestInfo.2: Someday, you might be able to play instruments well. Don't be jealous.

0.0: Well, #b#h0##k, it would seem #bCygnus#k has really gotten interested in playing instruments, as well. I'm sure she'll want to master this skill as well. She's passed on a request to you. Are you ready to help?

yes.0: Do you know about #bOrpheus's Sheet Music#k? Orpheus was a legendary bard, who was said to make the very trees and rocks dance to his music. No one knew the secret of his amazing melodies, but it is rumored that sheet music detailing his techniques is hidden somewhere in Maple World.
yes.1: I've heard that monsters have found the sheet music, and are now running amok with it. There should be #b8 different sheet music pages#k you can collect and bring to Cygnus. You can find these pages with #rall normal monsters#k, but not #bmonsters that are 11 levels higher or lower than you#k. Good luck!

no.0: I can't believe you would refuse her request like that... Are you not a true fan?

1.0: Let's see... Yes, this is all 8 pages! This is perfect!\r\n
1.1: Having this sheet music will go a long way, but it isn't enough. To become the Maple Rising Star, she should practice hard, using what you have so kindly brought. And you should cheer her on, all right?

npc.0: Take these to Cygnus at the Rising Star Hall!

item.0: You still don't have those pages? The sooner you find them, the sooner she can practice with them!
